messages:
Jenna (CS): FYI — a subset of trial tenants saw slow activations this morning. Need a short, customizable outbound + credit offer + quick enablement slots. Draft below, please review.

Mark (Support): What failed exactly? webhooks, reindex, or queueing?

Jenna (CS): Primarily webhook callback retries and the final reindex step. Incident window ~08:54-09:50 UTC. No data exposure. List of affected tenants in internal doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/impacted-trials

IncidentBot: INCIDENT-2026-0426 created for onboarding queue saturation. Severity P3.

Priya (CS Manager): Draft outbound copy (short, personalize for mid-market/SMB):

"Hi [Customer name],\n\nWe ran into an issue this morning that slowed some tenant activations. Root cause: a routing change that temporarily sent onboarding bursts to a saturated node pool. We reverted the change and cleared pending jobs.\n\nWe'd like to make this right: a 30-minute onboarding assist and a one-time onboarding credit (prorated for the impacted window). No customer data was exposed.\n\nIf you'd like an immediate assist, reply and well schedule. Feedback form: https://redwood.internal/cs/onboard-feedback\n\nThanks, Jenna (on behalf of Redwood Inference)"

Omar (Solutions Eng): Add a one-line technical summary for enterprise notes: regression in autoscaler route preference -> rollback + saturation guard + new queue-depth alert.

Liam (Sales Ops): For credits, default = prorated onboarding consumption during window. For accounts tagged as renewal-risk, apply 1.5x multiplier. I'll prepare memos and wire the default amounts.

Mark (Support): Recommendation: send enterprise/high-touch batch first, include AM cc and a calendar invite stub for a prioritized slot within 24 hours. Also include local-time conversion in each message.

Jenna (CS): Agreed. I'll update the template with exec-summary and local-time. Also add a tiny troubleshooting checklist to include in the email:
- confirm webhook endpoint returns 200
- check ingestion backlog > 0: `curl -s https://internal/metrics/onboard?tenant=... | jq .backlog`

Priya (CS Manager): I'll flag renewal-risk accounts in Salesforce and create follow-up tasks for renewals team. Capture all outbound copies in the account timeline.

Liam (Sales Ops): ETA for credit memos + AM list: 40m. Will mark any accounts for 1.5x after CS flags.

Jenna (CS): Send plan: enterprise at 11:30 UTC (AMs CC'd), SMB at 13:00 UTC. Action items:
- Omar: add exec-summary + tech blurb to template (ETA 10m)
- Liam: prepare credits + AM cc list (ETA 40m)
- Mark: queue sends and include calendar stub (ETA 20m)
- Priya: Salesforce flags + follow-ups (ETA 30m)

Mark (Support): Enterprise batch sent at 11:32 UTC. CCs included. Will ping here when SMB batch is done.

Priya (CS Manager): Two enterprise replies requesting immediate assist slots. Scheduling now and logging in account activity.

Mark (Support): SMB batch sent at 13:02 UTC. Low reply volume so far.

Jenna (CS): Closing notes: attach engineering postmortem when eng-runtime publishes, run 24h and 72h feedback pulses via the form, and update account health tracker with outcomes. Thanks team."
